summary: Frontend E2E test of Winnings Wallet + £50 Challenge + Admin Winnings Payouts. All 9 scenarios in the review request PASSED. Player already had £50 previously won so 'already won / practice' state was verified end-to-end. Randomization confirmed different across attempts. Practice completion did NOT credit again. Withdrawal (£20) moved funds from available→pending. Admin panel listed row with masked account (••••5678), filter chips work, Reveal Bank modal showed full unmasked details (holder/sort/number/amount/status), Reject with reason set status to 'rejected' and released funds back to user (avail returned to £20). A second withdrawal was created and Mark-as-Paid flipped status to 'paid' and increased user's total paid (£30→£50), pending returned to £0.
critical_code_review_comments: WinningsWallet.jsx line 56: `finish(seq)` inside setTimeout branch can double-fire on timeout because finish() is async and playing state flip races the effect. Consider guarding with a ref to prevent double POST to /challenge/complete when both timer expiry and n===100 race.

WinningsWallet.jsx: withdrawal form has no client-side validation for sort code (should be NN-NN-NN or 6 digits) or account number (typically 8 digits). Backend likely validates but UI should give quick feedback.
WinningsWallet.jsx line 176: 'Play again (practice)' button remains active while `busy` only during startChallenge; consider disabling when result modal open too.
WinningsPayoutsAdmin.jsx: no pagination/limit indicator on the list — could grow unbounded.
seed_data_creation: Testing created and consumed 2 withdrawal requests for player1 (one rejected via admin, one marked paid). Player1 final state: available £0, pending £0, total_won £50, total_paid £50.
